verdict.rationale: The evidence shows sevDesk does double-entry bookkeeping on a chart of accounts and that its trial balance displays journal entries. Nothing documents that an accountant can manually create and post a journal entry with balanced debit and credit lines and a memo. Viewing journal entries in a trial balance is an adjacent reporting feature, not the manual-posting capability itself.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos
